scope: Approved severity reclassification of existing pilot findings. Original captions and review evidence unchanged; no new visual inspection or owner approval.

policy.review_note: Minor precision or uncertain detail; shown in asset detail.
policy.warning: Meaningful descriptive error or uncertain interpretation that could mislead selection; nonblocking warning.
policy.fault: Derived from failed/incomplete caption processing or an unusable description; never downgraded by this file.

issues.evidence: White bumper claim is wrong: bumper is dark gray with a pale plate. Pixel-art style is a loose analogy, not pixel-art evidence; game/icon use belongs in suggestions.
issues.reason: A stated component color is wrong; color-based searches or selection could be misleading.

issues.evidence: Cab is predominantly red-orange with pale windshield, rather than a white cab; exact stripe placement is imprecise.
issues.reason: The cab's predominant color is described incorrectly, affecting color-based selection.

issues.evidence: Driver seat/steering wheel are not clearly visible through the pale windows; do not treat them as observed parts.
issues.reason: Tractor identity remains useful; obscured interior details should be treated as uncertain.

issues.evidence: Hexagonal cross-section claim is not clearly supported by the visible rounded/faceted outline; color gradient is mainly lighting.
issues.reason: Wheel identity remains useful; facet count and lighting terminology are minor detail cautions.

issues.evidence: Central vertical channel and elevated/raised border interpretation are not clearly supported by the thin flat surface.
issues.reason: Road identity remains useful; small channel and edge-height interpretations need qualification.

issues.evidence: Standing vertical/facing forward wording confuses image orientation with object pose; bars are flat horizontal pieces in the renderer convention.
issues.reason: The two-bar structure is recognized; orientation wording is a minor presentation detail.

issues.evidence: Bench identity, raised backrest, shelf and plank interpretation are visually misleading; the rendered structure has two broad decks and road markings.
issues.reason: The road bridge is described as furniture, a meaningful object-identity error.

issues.evidence: Street-light identity is uncertain; yellow rectangular housing is not a band wrapping a pole. Broad road signal/light possibilities should be uncertain.
issues.reason: The light's identity and housing structure are uncertain enough to mislead selection.

issues.evidence: No-visible-textures wording and color gradient should be read as appearance only; source texture absence is not established. Exact octagonal form is over-specific.
issues.reason: Apple identity and main colors agree; polygon count, lighting and texture wording are minor cautions.

issues.evidence: Eyes/eye-like indentations are a misleading interpretation of the seed-like marks; identity omits the important cut/half state.
issues.reason: The important cut/half state is omitted and seed marks are misinterpreted as eyes.

issues.evidence: Upper reddish layer interpreted as meat could be tomato-like; exact octagonal outline and extra patty should remain uncertain.
issues.reason: Burger identity remains useful; individual ingredient guesses and exact facet counts are minor cautions.

issues.evidence: Identity label bun is narrower than the complete hamburger visible and described; inferred patty/bread composition remains interpretation.
issues.reason: The identity label describes only a bun rather than the whole burger, which can mislead retrieval.

issues.evidence: Precise octagonal cap and horizontal stem ridges are not clearly supported; the rendered cap appears more sparsely faceted.
issues.reason: Mushroom identity remains useful; exact facet count and small stem ridges are uncertain details.

issues.evidence: Two legs is a view-dependent count rather than the visible four-leg chair; back has a top rail and one middle bar.
issues.reason: The visible chair's leg count and back structure are described incorrectly.

issues.evidence: Exact two-crossbar count is not accepted from these views; preserve general bracing observation only through future owner correction.
issues.reason: Chair identity and main structure agree; an exact crossbar count is a minor uncertain detail.

issues.evidence: Wood material/wooden texture are not established; red lower layer is largely shaded pink rather than a proven second bedding layer.
issues.reason: Bed identity remains useful; material inference and shaded bedding layers are minor appearance cautions.

issues.evidence: Calling the rounded protrusions spherical branches is an interpretation; exact count and placement should be qualified.
issues.reason: Tree identity remains useful; naming and counting rounded canopy forms is interpretive.

issues.evidence: Four-cylinder/central-column arrangement and octagonal center are over-specific and do not match the clearly separated perimeter cluster.
issues.reason: Arrangement, transparency and speculative identity claims can materially mislead selection of this rock cluster.

issues.evidence: Mineral deposit or sensor interpretation of a light spot is unsupported and appears in factual description rather than a separate interpretation.
issues.reason: Arrangement, transparency and speculative identity claims can materially mislead selection of this rock cluster.

issues.evidence: Translucent appearance is not supported by the opaque rendered surfaces.
issues.reason: Arrangement, transparency and speculative identity claims can materially mislead selection of this rock cluster.

issues.evidence: Two primary lobes misses the central upright form; symmetry and mossy material interpretation are not established.
issues.reason: The description misses a prominent central form; arrangement and material claims remain uncertain.

issues.evidence: Torii-gate/open-arch interpretation is misleading for the low arched deck with side rails; exact five blocks and hanging vertical posts are unsupported.
issues.reason: A bridge is interpreted as a gate, a meaningful object-identity error.

issues.evidence: Description says stem and leaf are both brown while the leaf is visibly green; glossary/species/material remain unverified.
issues.reason: The leaf's stated color is wrong, affecting color-based selection.

issues.evidence: Exact hexagonal outline and tomato count are not established; model distinguishes plausible food components rather than measured ingredients.
issues.reason: Burger identity remains useful; polygon and ingredient counts are minor uncertain details.

issues.evidence: Hexagonal cap and octagonal outline in the same description are contradictory and unsupported exact geometry labels.
issues.reason: Mushroom identity remains useful; inconsistent exact polygon terminology is a minor precision issue.

issues.evidence: Uniformly spaced toppings feature contradicts irregular distribution in prose and images; wood/rubber analogy is speculative.
issues.reason: Pizza identity remains useful; topping spacing and material analogies are minor descriptive cautions.

issues.evidence: Circular seat with rectangular outline is an inconsistent geometric attribute; actual fabric/wood material and exact slat count are unverified.
issues.reason: Contradictory seat geometry can mislead shape-based selection; material and count claims remain uncertain.

issues.evidence: No visible posts/support beams is wrong: the frame is visible at the head/foot and sides; headboard/backrest angle should not be inferred.
issues.reason: The description denies visible bed-frame supports, a meaningful structural error.

issues.evidence: Raised tabletop edge is not clearly established; rounded corners on circular top is imprecise.
issues.reason: Round table identity remains useful; edge treatment and corner wording are minor precision issues.

issues.evidence: Symmetrical overall form is too strong for the bent trunk and uneven canopy; no leaves visible means no individually resolved leaves, not absence of foliage.
issues.reason: Tree identity and foliage remain useful; symmetry and individually resolved leaf wording need qualification.

issues.evidence: Thick trunk and two branching supports are not clearly supported; visible trunk is slender. Brown-orange foliage masses are not individual giant leaves.
issues.reason: Trunk thickness and branching structure are described incorrectly; foliage masses are misinterpreted.

issues.evidence: Interior sections listed as observed parts are unsupported; only exterior facets are visible.
issues.reason: Rock identity remains useful; unsupported interior details should be treated as uncertain.
